mechanism: Nafcillin is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that increases dabigatran metabolism via P-glycoprotein induction, reducing dabigatran plasma concentrations and anticoagulant efficacy.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor anticoagulation closely with alternative antibiotic if necessary; consider switching to a direct oral anticoagulant not dependent on P-glycoprotein metabolism.
